name: f1-gdx-skill-multidimensional-feature-space
description: DB reader/writer for the F1_GDX_SKILL_MULTIDIMENSIONAL_FEATURE_SPACE (MFS) skill: assembles and normalizes one study's per-person feature space (F1) from the relational/BI sources already in GDX_HUMAN7, optionally cross-checking Neo4j, over the Firebird wire protocol (no native client library needed).
